title: Series (the head that clamps its pieces)
description: A series is an item of its own: a folder series/<LABEL>/ at the pipeline root with this head as series.json, the prose as construct.md and an append-only review.md. It does not move through the stages; it has its own status. The head carries the order of appearance — pieces[] — and a piece may exist here before it has a container: that is a planned piece. A container says which series it belongs to (meta.json: series); the head says where the piece stands in the sequence. verify checks both directions. A series that has no folder here does not exist.

label.description: The clamp: in the folder name (series/<LABEL>), in every piece's folder name and in its meta.json. Equal to the folder name; the name wins on conflict.

spine.description: The thesis in one sentence. What every piece serves; shown on the card.

editor.description: Who answers for the series — an id from people.json.

sourced_by.description: Who feeds the material — ids from people.json.

pieces.description: The order of appearance. Each ref is <LABEL>-<SERIES>-<NN>, e.g. SP-SIM-01 — label plus series number, because three pieces may share SIM-01. A ref without a container is a planned piece.

canon.description: Path of the series' own canon file (visual language and semantics under the brand), once it exists.

role.description: What this piece carries for the series — one line.
